I made time to attend my dental appointment.
Unfortunately, I found a lazy doctor.
He couldn't assess my teeth to provide advice. He looked at my teeth and didn't even poke them. Before the x-ray, he immediately made a decision: if I didn't need a root canal, I'd have to extract them.
When the images came out, he didn't explain the damage to the tooth. He just pointed it out.
He then told me to schedule an appointment with another doctor. If I wanted a root canal, it would be done very quickly.

On Tuesday, the dentist was incredibly kind. Even someone like me, who is afraid of dentists, felt so relaxed. The dentist treated my teeth with such genuine care and a truly friendly atmosphere.
She kept telling me where it might hurt, but I have to say, it didn't hurt at all! Her touch was so gentle. She took better care of my teeth than other clinics I've been to. I used my government health insurance, and the service was excellent; it was free of charge, with no extra costs. The reception staff were also very lovely. If I need dental work done again in the future, I'll definitely choose this clinic. Parking is convenient, right next to a 7-Eleven.
